# Byalance — Your Compliance Executive

> Byalance is Your Compliance Executive, simplifying compliance and powering growth for modern businesses in India and globally.
> We serve startup founders, R&D labs, SMEs, MSMEs, hardware innovators, and global enterprises.
> Our services cover Global Procurement & Import Compliance, Employer of Record (EOR India), Accounting & Bookkeeping, GST, TDS, Payroll, and ITR filing.
> We also offer a white-label back-office execution service for home-based Chartered Accountants (CAs) across India.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://byalance.in/): Overview of services, pricing, and interactive compliance studio
- [Services](https://byalance.in/#services): Full suite of global procurement, EOR, accounting, and tax compliance services
- [Pricing](https://byalance.in/#pricing): Differentiated pricing plans for domestic Indian compliance vs global operations (EOR & Procurement)
- [About](https://byalance.in/#about): About Byalance, its mission, and compliance executive standard
- [Contact](https://byalance.in/#contact): WhatsApp and email contact, office location in JP Nagar, Bengaluru
- [Global Procurement & Import Compliance](https://byalance.in/services/procurement-import-compliance): Outsourced global sourcing, supplier forex payment, customs clearance, & GST tax invoice
- [Employer of Record (EOR) India](https://byalance.in/services/eor-services-india): Compliant hiring and payroll in India without setting up a local entity
- [Privacy Policy](https://byalance.in/privacy-policy): Compliant with DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000
- [Data Handling Policy](https://byalance.in/data-handling-policy): How client financial data is stored, processed, and protected

## Executive Services

- [Global Procurement & Import Compliance](https://byalance.in/services/procurement-import-compliance): End-to-end global product sourcing, international supplier FX payment, HSN classification, customs clearance, DHL/FedEx coordination, and doorstep delivery with 100% compliant GST Tax Invoice for ITC
- [Employer of Record (EOR) India](https://byalance.in/services/eor-services-india): Compliant talent onboarding, INR salary disbursement, statutory EPF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and TDS filings under Byalance corporate codes
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping](https://byalance.in/#bookkeeping): Monthly ledger management, bank reconciliation, P&L and Balance Sheet preparation
- [GST Filing & Compliance](https://byalance.in/#gst): Monthly/quarterly GST return filing (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9), GST registration, GST notices, e-invoicing
- [TDS Compliance](https://byalance.in/#tds): TDS deduction, challan payment, quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q)
- [Payroll Processing](https://byalance.in/#payroll): Monthly payroll, salary slips, PF/ESI compliance, Form 16 issuance
- [Income Tax Returns (ITR)](https://byalance.in/#itr): ITR filing for individuals, proprietors, freelancers, and small businesses
- [CA White-Label Service](https://byalance.in/#ca-partners): Back-office execution for home-based CAs — Byalance handles the execution, CA retains client ownership

## Pricing Summary

- Global Procurement & Import Compliance: Custom landed-cost quote in INR with 100% compliant GST Tax Invoice for Input Tax Credit
- Employer of Record (EOR) Service Fee: Flat $89/employee/month (USD) — Pass-through direct employee CTC and statutory taxes with zero markup
- Starter Compliance Plan: ₹2,499/month — Basic GST filing, TDS challans, quarterly ITR support, & ledger entries
- Growth Operations Plan: ₹4,999/month — Full compliance stack including monthly bookkeeping, GST GSTR-1/3B, TDS 24Q/26Q, & payroll
- Scale & Enterprise Plan: ₹9,999/month — End-to-end financial operations, dedicated account manager, & priority SLA
